chapters: Ba' jix aa' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Moisees bɨx gu Israeel dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan oidha' jix gaki jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu gɨ' suudai' gu suudai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Paraan gu Topel gu Labaan gu aserot gu Disaab.
Jano' ba' gu kutun gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham tu'x jai'ch dɨr gu oreb gu bhóogɨt gu kavɨk gu Seir bɨɨx ka'm gu Kades-barnea.
Ba' jix aa' ka't oo'm gu takarui' gu tasi' maa'n gu takarui' gu Moisees gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jurtu'nka' bɨx tu'x gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk mi' dhɨr naaka'n gu kutun gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos jix daa gu esboon gu Og gu gɨ'kora' gu Basaan jix daa gu Astarot gu Edrei.
Jano' ba' dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu oidha' gu Moab jix duñia' gu Moisees gu suudai' dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga bham.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu oreb bham; gio ba' jix bhai'x jix duñia' dhi' gu kavɨk.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu kavɨk gu Amorreo bɨx jugi jix duñia' gu kavɨk gu suudai' saagi'ñ gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ' suudai' gu oidha' gu Kananeo gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Euprates.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' jix maa gu oidha' gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' kapbhai' bia'ka' gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tattat gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Jakob gu ñi'ook gu kai' mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook jano' ba' bham; gio ba' tu' cham gu takarui' jix duñia' gu duukam.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu si'avag gu tɨkɨr gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tattat gu suudai' bhaan gu ñi'ook na ja'p jix bhai'x mui'kim gu jodai' na ja'p tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' tu' gu duukam gu takarui' gu tasi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix maa tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook bopxi'ñ gu chichio'ñ mamatdagɨm pui'm gu ñi'ook na ba' tu' jix duñia' gu ux gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gui'p; gio ba' jix bhai' duñia' tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook bopxi'ñ gu chichio'ñ mamatdagɨm gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu ux gu takarui' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' mambhɨɨx mo'o mambhɨɨx gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' bopxi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu bhóogɨt bham; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu chuukug tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chio'ñ xibhɨk ja'tkam mii' dhɨr.

Jano' ba' cham gu ja'tkam gu i'ii'ñ gu bhóogɨt ñi'ook na jir bhai'; gio ba' jix ali' na ja'p jix gɨ' gu bhóogɨt; na gu' cham jix duñia' choo'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na gu' ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' kuiñcha ka't gu ux gu bhóogɨt tu' tu jiim.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook bɨx gu suudai' duñia'.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu oreb gu chuukug bɨx mii' dhɨr jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki jix duñia' buupui gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu kavɨk gu Amorreo na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix aa'ñdhix; gio ba' gu jodai' bɨɨx ka'm gu Kades-barnea.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu kavɨk gu Amorreo gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa vupui bhaan tu' gu oidha'; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu suudai' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tattat tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham jum i'obh tu' gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' tu' bɨx gu takarui' gui'p; gio ba' gu chuukug gu chichio'ñ vupui bhaan no'ch gu jodai' gu oidha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt gu ux pai' gu jodai' jix tɨ'ɨ jɨ'dɨlh gu suudai' gu jodai' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu kutun gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu ux bopxi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix tɨ'ɨ gu kavɨk jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu suudai' gu Eskol jix duñia' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu noobh gu i'bhɨ gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ aichdhak jix maa jix duñia' gui'p; gio ba' jix bhai' gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook cham jix duñia' jix tɨ'ɨ va'k jix bɨɨx duu gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' vaak zel bham; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt tu' jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto na ba' kapbhai' gu novɨ gu Amorreo na ba' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' duukat jix tɨ'ɨ xibhɨk gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' chulhiiñdha' gu i'ii'ñ bham; gio ba' dhi' gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x no'ch jɨ'dɨlh vaak jodai bɨɨx ka'm gu tɨkɨr; mi' dhɨr gio gu chuukug gu ma'nkam gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu takarui' tu' gu ja'tkam ɨɨbhi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios tu' vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' bɨx tu'x gu ux gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto vupui bhaan gu vupui.
Jano' ba' oidha' jix gaki buupui gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu jodai' na ja'p jix duñia' gu chio'ñ gu mar gu ux bɨx gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia' tɨbiap dhi' pai'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' bɨɨx dhi' cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook gu ux gu bhóogɨt na ba' gu takarui' pai' gu suudai' yooxi' bɨɨx gu tai gu tukaa' na ba' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu ux pai' gu takarui' bɨɨx toov gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix kai gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bhaam gu ñi'ook bham.
Jano' ba' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chio'ñ oi'ñdha' dhi' ja'tkam dhi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jix bhai' gu oidha' gu takarui' ka't gu chuukug tattat.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu oidha' jix duñia' gu ma'nkam; na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gio bhaan tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu takarui' bham; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' ba'k.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun vupui bhaan tu' jix duñia'; gio ba' gu takarui'; na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gui'p ka't gu ux gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam cham gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook jix bhai' tu' cham bhai' jɨjɨkgɨm gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt oidha' jix gaki gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gui'p; gio ba' uañi'ñ gu jodai' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr no'ch jix tɨ'ɨ gu suudai' jurtu'nka' bɨx gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix aa'ñdhix; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook maa'n gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham jix duñia' na ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu kavɨk.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr cham jix tɨ'ɨ tu' gu oi'ñga'n cham dhi' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui'; na gu' cham ka't gu chuukug vupui bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook cham jix maa naak; gio ba' va'k jix bɨɨx duu gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' bɨɨx gu suudai' jix tɨ'ɨ gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu Amorreo jix daa mii' dhɨr gu kavɨk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' na ja'p xoi'kam gu suudai' jix duñia' gu Seir gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm gu orma.
Jano' ba' suulh gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham jix kai gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' naak.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Kades gu ux mui'x gu tanoolh na ja'p gu tanoolh jix duñia' dhi'.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n oidha' jix gaki gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu Seir gu ux mui'x gu tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' jix bhai'x jix duñia' dhi' gu kavɨk; gio ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bham; gio ba' bhɨi gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ñi'ook xibhɨk gu ma'nkam gu Esauu gu bhóogɨt gu Seir jix duñia' ɨɨbhi'ñ gu ñi'ook; gu' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n jix jai'.
Jano' ba' cham gu takarui' bɨɨx; na cham gu suudai' gu oidha' tu' gu suudai' gu chuukug gu vaas tɨɨt; na gu' tu' jix maa gu ux gu maa'nkar gu Esauu gu kavɨk gu Seir.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ux tuumiñ koi' jugi; gio ba' gio gu ñi'ook gu suudai' i'i.

Na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu takarui' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu noobh; gio ba' gu maa'nkar jiim gu ux dhi' oidha' jix gaki; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam oo'm gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨndak; jano' ba' matgɨm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' xibhɨk gu ma'nkam gu Esauu oi'ñka' gu Seir gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu Elat gu Esiongeber; gio ba' gu takarui' gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt oidha' jix gaki gu Moab.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu chuukug gu Moab tu' gu suudai' bɨɨx bhɨɨ'ñdham cham tu' gu suudai' gu maa'nkar gu oidha'; na gu' tu' jix maa gu Ar gu ux gu maa'nkar gu ma'nkam gu Lot.
Jano' ba' gu Emimeos jix daa va'k gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' jix bhai'x na ja'p gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gio gu oi'ñga'n na ja'p gu Anakeos; gio ba' gu Moabitas mɨmɨim gu Emimeos.

Jano' ba' gu Seir jix daa va'k gu oreos mi'x juu'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Esauu; gio ba' gu chuukug vupui bhaan jix koi pai'; mi' dhɨr na ja'p jix duu gu Israeel gu oidha' gu maa'nkar jix maa gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jano' jix duñia' gu jodai' gu Sered; gio ba' gu jodai' gu Sered.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu chuukug gu Kades-barnea bɨɨx ka'm gu jodai' gu Sered jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook gu tasi' gu takarui'; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm jix bɨɨx duu bɨx gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham tɨjɨɨ'ñ yooxi' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gio gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan na ba' cham tu' duu tɨjɨɨ'ñ yooxi' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk a'lhiok gu ñi'ook koi bɨx gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Moab gu Ar.

Jano' ba' tu' gu takarui' vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon; gio ba' cham gu chuukug tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx; na gu' cham tu' no'ñ gu chuukug gu maa'nkar gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon; na gu ma'nkam gu Lot jix maa gu ux gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu oidha' gu ñi'ook ka't gio gu takarui'; gio ba' jix daa gu ñi'ook gu Ammonitas tɨɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' jix bhai'x na ja'p gu Anakeos; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Ammonitas jix duñia' jix daa pai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu na ja'p bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Esauu oi'ñka' gu Seir vupui bhaan jix duñia' gu oreos; gio ba' jix duñia' jix daa pai' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' oi'ñka' gu vaak bɨɨx ka'm gu Gasa gu Kaptoreos moor gu Kaptor gu chuukug jix daa pai'; gio ba'.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu jodai' gu Arnoon; gio ba' gu suudai' jix maa gu novɨ gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu esboon gu Amorreo gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr jugi jix bhɨɨ gu maa'nkar gu chuukug bɨɨx bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook kua'da' gu takarui' ɨɨbhi'ñ gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ja'tkam bɨtaa'n bɨx gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook jix duñia' vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu takarui' dɨr oidha' jix gaki gu takarui' gu kutun gu gɨ'kora' gu esboon bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bhai'x i'ii'ñ bham.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ux gu oidha' gu ux gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu ux gu bhóogɨt tu jiim cham gu takarui' kɨɨ'n tu' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jugi bi'iix gu ux tuumiñ jugi; gio ba' gu suudai' gio maa'n gu ux tuumiñ i'ya'; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' tɨɨt.

Jano' ba' na ja'p jix duu gu chuukug gu ma'nkam gu Esauu oi'ñka' gu Seir gu Moabitas oi'ñka' gu Ar; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu oi'ñga'n gu Jordaan gu oidha' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.

Gu' gu' gu kutun gu gɨ'kora' gu esboon cham gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu kutun; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu jodai' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ na ba' kɨɨsa' gu novɨ na ja'p gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' kua'da' gu chuukug vupui bhaan tu' gu Seoon gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr jugi jix bhɨɨ gu maa'nkar na ba' gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu kutun gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jaas.
Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu takarui' do'ñcho vupui bhaan no'ch; gio ba' gu takarui' gu ma'nkam bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ jano' ba' bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu takarui' bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ a'aalh; gio ba' cham mi'x dhaas gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix bhɨɨ na ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaakax gu takarui' jɨ'dɨlh dua'ñ jix bhɨɨ.

Jano' ba' dɨr gu Aroer ju'ñdharan gu vaak gu jodai' gu Arnoon kiicham gu jodai' bɨɨx ka'm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham ka't kiicham gu takarui' no'ch; gio ba' bɨx do'ñcho gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon cham gu oi'ñga'n tu' bɨx jugii'ñ gu jodai' gu Jabok tu' jɨ'dɨlh gu kavɨk tu' pai' oi'ñdha' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' jix tɨ'ɨ gu bhóogɨt gu Basaan jix buus gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Og gu gɨ'kora' gu Basaan na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Edrei.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ choo'n na gu' gu novɨ dhagia' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr jix duu bɨɨx na ja'p gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu kutun gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreo jix daa gu esboon.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gio gu kutun gu novɨ gu Og gu gɨ'kora' gu Basaan bɨx gu ja'tkam gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm cham gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ jano' ba' bɨx jɨ'dɨlh; gio ba' cham jix duñia' kiicham cham jix bhɨɨ; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh bɨx gu oidha' gu Argob oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Og gu Basaan.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu suudai' jix duñia' jɨ'dɨlh gu takarui' bɨɨx jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook bɨɨx kiki'ñgob gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' cham gu bhóogɨt mumua'da' jɨ'dɨlh cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ja'p gu jodai' gu kutun gu gɨ'kora' gu esboon jix duñia' bɨx kiicham gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ a'aalh.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ na ba' no'ch bɨx gu vaakax gu takarui' jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' gio jix bhɨɨ mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gook gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos mi'p dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu oidha' dɨr gu jodai' gu Arnoon bɨɨx ka'm gu kavɨk gu ermoon.
Jano' ba' gu Sidonios mɨmɨim gu chuukug gu Sirioon; gio ba' gu Amorreos gu Senir; mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu Basaan bɨɨx ka'm gu Salkâ gu Edrei jɨ'dɨlh oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Og gu Basaan.

Na gu' na gu' gu oi'ñga'n gu Og gu gɨ'kora' gu Basaan ka't jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu suudai' gu takarui' jix kavɨk jodai cham gu Rabbat gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook maakobh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ novɨ maa'nkar gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu oidha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jano' ba' dɨr gu Aroer gu jodai' gu Arnoon tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kavɨk gu Galaad bɨɨx jɨ'dɨlh tu' gu jodai' gu Gaditas.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu Basaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Og tu' ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees; gio ba' bɨx gu oidha' gu Argob bɨx gu Basaan tɨɨt gu oidha' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Jair gu mar gu Manasees jix bhɨɨ bɨx gu oidha' gu Argob bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu Gessuri gu Makâti; gio ba' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Basaan-abot-jair bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Makîr tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu Gaditas tu' gu Galaad bɨɨx ka'm gu jodai' gu Arnoon tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' gu ux gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu jodai' gu Jabok gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' vaak ja'tkam gu Jordaan gu ñi'ook dɨr gu Kineret bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' jix duñia' gu gɨ' suudai' gu Salado gu oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ gu Pisga tas buusñi.

Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix jano' ba' bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa dhi' gu oidha' na ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan xibhɨk gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨx jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu u'vɨ a'aalh gu suudai' tu' namki' jix jai' gu vaakax jix duñia' jɨ'dɨlh jix maa.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu Jawatan Dios jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' gu ja'tkam na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ gu suudai' gio gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa baasɨ'n gu Jordaan; gio ba' jano' ba' gu ñi'ook maa'n gu maa'nkar tu' jix maa.

Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gio gu Josuee jano' ba' bham; gio ba' gu vupui jix duñia' bɨx gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gook gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu suudai' tu'.
Jano' ba' cham gu takarui'; na gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook bham.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios tu' kua'da' gu takarui' tu duukam gu duukam gu novɨ jix kavɨk; na gu' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios cham tu'x jai'ch gu tɨkɨr tu' gu oidha' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan buimɨi bhaan gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n tu' jix duñia' gu chuukug mii' dhɨr gu oidha' jix bhai' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan mii' dhɨr jix bhai' gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix bhai'x bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook kuiñcha gu ñi'ook cham jix kai; gio ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt cham tu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n dhi' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu ux gu Pisga gu ñi'ook gu vupui tas gei'ñ gu ñi'ook saagi'ñ tas buusñi tu' gu ux gu vupui; na gu' cham gu suudai' dhi' gu Jordaan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Josuee gu takarui' gu suudai'; na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan dhi' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' vupui bhaan gu Bet-peor.

Jano' ba' jano' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu takarui' ñi'ook kavɨk gu suudai' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' gu suudai' gu chuukug kapbhai' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tattat tu' jix maa.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu takarui' tu' gu oi'ñga'n na ba' nukadham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu vupui jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Baal-peor; na bɨx gu chio'ñ ka't gu ñi'ook gu Baal-peor jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Gu' gu' gu takarui' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx ko'iix gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' jix duñia' ñi'ook kavɨk gu suudai' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix na ba' xoi'kam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' ba'k na ba' bia'ka'.

Jano' ba' nukadham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux tu duukam; na gu' dhi' matda' gu ja'tkam gu vupui gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt bɨx dhi' ja'tkam ñi'ook kavɨk gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam jix bhai'x gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' gu chuukug.
Na gu' na gu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' cham tu'x jai'ch jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios mia'n na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' cham tu'x jai'ch jix duñia' ñi'ook kavɨk gu suudai' jir bhai' ja'tkam na ja'p bɨx dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu takarui'.

Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu ñi'ook jix nukadham gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu ñi'ook cham tu' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x tu'x gu vupui jix duñia' buupui tu' gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha'; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam.

Ba' jix aa' gu tanoolh gu chuukug vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu oreb na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu chuukug gu ja'tkam na ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na ba' gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu tanoolh gu chuukug bhaan gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix dhaas tɨɨt gu kavɨk; gio ba' gu kavɨk gu tanoolh gu tai bɨɨx ka'm tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tɨkɨr bɨɨx gu tukgam toov gu tukgam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bhaan tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai; gio ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu' gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook matgɨm gu kutun jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' ñi'ook na jix bhaan jix aa'ñdhix gu takarui' gu ux tu duukam mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ua'na gook gu bhóogɨt gu jodai.
Jano' ba' tu' gio jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk gu suudai' na ba' jix dhaas gu ux tu duukam gu oidha' gu suudai' na ba' bia'ka'.
Jano' ba' nukadham jix jai' gu i'ii'ñ; na gu' matgɨm gu kutun jix duñia' gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook bɨɨx bhaan tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai.
Na gu' na gu' cham gu oi'ñga'n xoi'kam na ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak na jax chu'm gu kutun gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu kutun gu vaakax ka't gu oidha' gu kutun gu u'uvhig gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu kutun gu oi'ñga'n gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu oi'ñga'n ko'oi na oi'ñga'n chɨt tu jiim gu ux gu oidha' gu kutun gu vatop oi'ñdha' ka't gu suudai' bɨtaa'n gu oidha'.

Na gu' na gu' gu bhóogɨt gu vupui gu tɨkɨr ñɨi'ñ gu tas gu masad gu si'avag bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tɨkɨr cham gu ñi'ook gu suudai' tu' gu takarui' gu chuukug; na gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' tu' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨtaa'n bɨx gu tɨkɨr.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios jix bhɨɨ tu' jix buusñi gu i'ii'ñ jix kavɨk jodai gu Ejipto na ba' ka't gu ux gu ja'tkam gu maa'nkar na ja'p dhi' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios bhaam bhaan tu' bhaan gu takarui' gu ñi'ook tu' cham gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan tu' ba'k jix bhai' gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa gu ux gu maa'nkar.
Na ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ koi dhi' gu oidha'; gio ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu Jordaan; gu' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr jix bhai' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n cham gu oi'ñga'n ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios dhi' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu vaak na jax chu'm gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu suudai'.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tai gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai'x.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug gu oidha' gu oi'ñga'n xoi'kam gu vaak na jax chu'm gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ xoi'kam cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' gu Yo jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ñi'ook gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' jootom jix koi jix bhai'x gu oidha' bhaan gu suudai' gu Jordaan na ba' bia'ka'; gio ba' cham no'm jix duñia' gu tanoolh cham ka't gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu jodai' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu juan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu noobh gu chichio'ñ gu u'u gu jodai cham gu kutun tu' gu suudai' tu' kua'da' tu' gu oi'ñga'n.
Gu' gu' tu' dɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bakia' tu' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu i'ii'ñ.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug tu' gu takarui' bɨx dhi' tu'x tu' gu bhóogɨt gu tanoolh tu' gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham tu' kiicha' tu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x ñi'ook na jix bhaan tattat gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix duu na gu' tu ñi'ook jano' gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' va'k tu' dɨr gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ bhaan gu oidha' dɨr gu maa'nkar gu tɨkɨr tu' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ nɨidhim dhi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't naak na ja'p.
Jano' ba' tu' naak gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai na ja'p tu' naak jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' jix duu tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tasi' jix ai jix bhɨɨ na ba' gu ja'tkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu kutun bɨɨx buimɨk bɨɨx gu ux bɨɨx bhɨɨ'ñdham gu novɨ jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' bhaan bɨx tu'x bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Ejipto vupui bhaan gu vupui.
Jano' ba' tu' ka't gu oi'ñga'n na ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu oi'ñga'n mai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tɨkɨr tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook na ba' gu suudai'; gio ba' bhaan gu oidha' tu' jix duñia' gu tai; mi' dhɨr naak gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai.
Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' tattat jix duñia' gu kai' mi' dhɨr tu' jix buusñi vupui bhaan gu Ejipto bɨɨx gu suudai'.
Na ba' na ba' mi'x juu'ñ vupui bhaan tu' chɨbɨɨp gu oi'ñga'n jix kavɨk tu' na ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu ux gu maa'nkar na ja'p gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jiix gu tɨkɨr gu i'ii'ñ bhaan gu oidha'; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch.

Jano' ba' jix nukadham ñi'ook kavɨk gu ñi'ook tu' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook na ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook tu' gu ma'nkam mi' dhɨr tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh bhaan gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix ai'chdhix gu Moisees vaik jɨ'dɨlh dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu jodai' gu tas.
Na ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook mua'kam gu ñi'ook tɨtmo gu i'ii'ñ gu vaak cham gu suudai' jix duñia' gu jodai' bɨɨx dɨr gu ñi'ook tu' va'k gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu chuukug dhi' jɨ'dɨlh dodhia' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu Beser oidha' jix gaki gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt gu jodai'; gio ba' gu Ramot gu Galaad gu Gaditas; mi' dhɨr gu Golaan gu Basaan gu Manasees.
Jano' ba' dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Moisees jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Na pai' dhuuk dhi' ja'tkam gu i'ii'ñ ñi'ook kavɨk gu suudai' gu Moisees jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na pai' dhuuk a'lhiok gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto.

Na pai' dhuuk dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu suudai' vupui bhaan gu Bet-peor gu oidha' gu kutun gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos jix daa gu esboon naaka'n gu Moisees bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na pai' dhuuk a'lhiok gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu vupui gu oidha' gu Og gu gɨ'kora' gu Basaan; gio ba' gook gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos mi'p dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu jodai' gu tas.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu Aroer ju'ñdharan gu vaak gu jodai' gu Arnoon bɨɨx ka'm gu kavɨk gu Sioon gu ermoon.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu bhóogɨt dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan tas buusñi bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ gu Pisga.
Ba' jix aa' jup tɨɨt gu Moisees bɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' gu takarui' gu Israeel ñi'ook kavɨk gu suudai' tu' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook maatɨt; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook nukadham na ba' jix duñia' gu ux tu duukam.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx no'ch gu oreb.
Jano' ba' jix duu cham bɨɨx taata'n tattat gu Jawatan Dios dhi' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu ñi'ook bɨɨx no'ch bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook ko'iix.
Ba' jix aa' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai.
Jano' ba' tu' ka't jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook na ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu ñi'ook chooto'n choo'n gu tai cham jix tɨ'ɨ gu kavɨk; mi' dhɨr bham.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu vaak tu duukam.
Jano' ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' cham jix duu na ba' tu' gu vaak tu' na jax chu'm gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jiix gu tɨkɨr gu i'ii'ñ gu oidha' gu suudai' bɨtaa'n gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' cham tu' gu chuukug tu' gu bhóogɨt; na gu' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix kavɨk jix bhai'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook tattat bhaan gu ma'nkam bhaan gu tanoolh bhaan jix bhai'x gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' nukadham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham jix bhɨɨ jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham maa'n gu ux gu tasi' jix bhɨɨ jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' nukadham gu tanoolh jɨɨpi'ñka' na ba' jix bhaan na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix aa'ñdhix.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu tanoolh gu suudai' jix duu bɨx gu ñi'ook.

Gu' gu' kɨɨv jɨɨpi'ñka' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' matgɨm gu ñi'ook jix duu tu' gu mar tu' mar u'vɨ tu' tu duukam tu' gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios tu' gu vaakax tu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu oi'ñga'n tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook kiki'ñgob; na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu duukam gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios na ja'p tu'.

Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook tu duukam gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix buusñi bɨɨx gu novɨ jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu ux gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix aa'ñdhix nukadham gu tanoolh jɨɨpi'ñka'.
Jano' ba' gu onra gu taat gu naan na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix aa'ñdhix na ba' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh na ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook bhaan gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa.
Jano' ba' cham koo'nda'.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham bɨɨna'.
Jano' ba' cham daipu' ɨɨxi'ñdha' chuut bhaan tɨtmo.

Jano' ba' cham gu jodai' gu u'vɨ tɨtmo tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu vaak tɨtmo tu' gu oidha' tu' tu duukam tu' gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios tu' gu vaakax tu' gu ñi'ook tu' matgɨm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't tɨtmo.
Ba' jix aa' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu takarui' gu kavɨk tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai toov gu tukgam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr ua'na gook gu bhóogɨt gu jodai jix maa tu'.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p gu takarui' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tukgam jix duñia' gu kavɨk gu tanoolh gu tai jix duñia' tu' bɨx chiñia' bopxi'ñ daraa.

Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu oi'ñga'n gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu duukam gu jodai' naak gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu jodai' buupui gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu ux jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jano' gu ux gu ñi'ook koi dhi' gu tai gu takarui'; gio ba' tu' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios koi.
Jano' ba' na gu' gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu chuukug na ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na jix do'ig tu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu tai.

Jano' ba' gu takarui' tu' gu takarui' bɨx tu'x gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' daipu' bɨx gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu takarui' no'ch gu chuukug chulhiiñchuda'.

Na pai' dhuuk jix kai gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr naak gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam tu' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx jix duñia' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' chɨkka gu takarui' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu jodai' nukadham bɨx gu tanoolh bɨx gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ma'nkam jum duu gu ñi'ook na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' tu' gu takarui'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook vaak zel.
Jano' ba' tu' gu chuukug tu' gu suudai' bɨx gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' jano' gu ux tu duukam gu oidha' tu' gu chuukug na ba' bia'ka'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' xoi'kam na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix aa'ñdhix; gio ba' cham gu suudai' kɨɨ'n tu' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix aa'ñdhix na ba' gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n xoi'kam gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu tanoolh gu oidha' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu ñi'ook na ba' gu suudai' gu ux tu duukam gu oidha' gu suudai' gu takarui' na ba' bia'ka'.

Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios maa'n.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx bɨx gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook tu' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook no'm bhaan gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' daipu' gu mar; gio ba' no'ch jɨɨ'ñdhat tu duukam gu Faraoon gu Ejipto gu Jawatan Dios jix buusñi gu Ejipto bɨɨx gu novɨ jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios buimɨk gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu Ejipto bhaan gu Faraoon bhaan bɨx gu vaak vupui bhaan gu vupui.
Jano' ba' jix buusñi na ba' gu chuukug gu takarui' gu oidha' gu ñi'ook taata'n tattat.

Na pai' dhuuk gu bhóogɨt bɨx bhai' na pai' dhuuk gu takarui' gu ux tu duukam bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p tu' jix aa'ñdhix.

Jano' ba' cham gu suudai' bɨɨx; gio ba' cham maa'n mar u'vɨ gu mar tu' jix bhɨɨ mar u'vɨ na ba' gu mar.
Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' gu mar gu ñi'ook tu' tu juan gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' i'iich gu Jawatan Dios gu tai bhaan gu ñi'ook tu' tu jiim jootom.
Gu' gu' jix duñia' duñia' bɨɨx; gio ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' dhi' jix duñia' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu tai.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu chuukug gu ja'tkam jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tasi' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu ja'tkam bhaan gu vupui gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' cham gu ux gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu ja'tkam tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tasi'; na gu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak bɨx gu ja'tkam.

Na gu' gu ñi'ook na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n nukadham gu ñi'ook tattat tu' jix buusñi gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu novɨ jix kavɨk tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak tu duukam gu novɨ gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix maati' gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n jix nukadham ñi'ook na jix bhaan xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu takarui' nukadham gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm jix bhai'x gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu kutun gu bhóogɨt bhaamki'ñ gu takarui'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt maa'n gu kutun.
Jano' ba' jix nukadham gu ux gu jodai' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk gu suudai' tu' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ux gu suudai' naak dhi' ja'tkam gu suudai' nukadham gu bhóogɨt gu ux tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios nukadham bɨndak ñi'ook na jix bhaan xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu ñi'ook tattat.

Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' tu' jix bhai' aa' tu' jix mui' jix bhai' aa' gu i'bhɨ vook gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' kai'ñ gu bhóogɨt bɨ'ñdhatu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' kakneer gu oidha' gu ñi'ook tattat tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' ka' gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu chio'ñ tu' gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook tu' gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' bɨx ko'kdai'; gio ba' bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu Ejipto tu' ñɨidhat cham gu bhóogɨt bhaan tu' va'k gu bhóogɨt bhaan bɨx tu' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug bɨx gu ja'tkam tu' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham uañi'ñka' gu vupui; mi' dhɨr tu' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' dhi' chɨbɨɨp mumua'da' gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ choo'n; gio ba' gu takarui' xoi'kam jix duu gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu Faraoon bɨɨx bɨx gu Ejipto.

Jano' ba' gu kutun jix duñia' gu vupui buimɨk gu ux gu novɨ jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix buusñi; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n tu' jum i'obh.
Jano' ba' gio gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' na jix uam vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' cham gu suudai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios mi'x juu'ñ dhi' chɨbɨɨp vupui bhaan tu' gu vaak; na gu' cham gu kutun gu ñi'ook na gu' gu vaakax yooxi' cham gu takarui' bhaan tu'.
Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' kapbhai' vupui bhaan tu' jix duñia' bɨɨx jix gɨ' gu jodai' bɨɨx ka'm ka't gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' kapbhai' gu gɨ'kora' gu novɨ tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨtaa'n gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' soo'mchulhdhak tu' jix duñia' jix bhai'x bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu tai; na gu' cham gu jodai' jix toja jodai tu' jix uam jodai bhaan na ba' jix bhɨɨ na ba' tu' na gu' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu i'ii'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' cham gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu vaak na gu' cham gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui'; na gu' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook cham tu' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Jawatan Dios na ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu suudai' ñi'ook kavɨk tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix duu tu' jiim gu ux oidha' jix gaki jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook gu ko'oi gu vaak gu jodai' gu duukam pai' gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' ka't tu' jix buusñi gu suudai' gu jodai' na jix uam gu ux.
Na tu' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu takarui' oidha' jix gaki jugi tattat cham gu suudai' gu tasi' gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n na ba' gu takarui' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' va'k gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' jix maa gu suudai' na ba' gu ñi'ook namkɨm gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu ñi'ook tattat na ja'p dhi' gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan na ba' baakɨi gu ñi'ook chɨbɨɨp gu oi'ñga'n jix kavɨk tu' jɨ'dɨlh gu chuukug bɨɨx ka'm gu tɨkɨr.

Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu maa'nkar cham gu ux bɨx bhai' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa dhi' jix bhai' gu oidha' na ba' bia'ka'; na gu ja'tkam jix bhai'x gu suudai' gu chuukug tu'.

Jano' ba' ka't gu maa'nkar oo'm gu tanoolh oo'm gu tukaa' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa gook gu bhóogɨt gu jodai gu bhóogɨt ñi'ook na jix bhaan.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bamii' gu chuukug jootom; na gu ja'tkam jix buusñi gu Ejipto tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; jano' ba' gu chuukug jix duñia' gu vaak gu bhóogɨt tu' jix aa'ñdhix; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' buupui gu takarui' gu ja'tkam gu suudai' gu ja'tkam jix bhai'x gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨtaa'n gu tɨkɨr; na tu' gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu ja'tkam jix kavɨk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p va'k oo'm gu tanoolh oo'm gu tukaa'; gio ba' cham jugi gu takarui' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' kuiñcha bɨx uañi'ñ gu suudai' jugi gu vupui cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu bhóogɨt.
Na gu' na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kuiñcha i'iich daak bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix bhai'x bhaan gu ñi'ook na ba' cham tu' duu; gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix kai gu bhóogɨt dhi' jix duñia'.
