Jano' ba' gio gu Tabera gu Massa gu Kibrot-ataaba jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios bhañ dɨr gu Kades-barnea bham jix tɨ'ɨ bia'ka' gu oidha' tu' jix maa; gio ba' gio jix bɨɨx duu gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios dɨr gu tanoolh tu' kakasnira'.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios oo'm gu tanoolh oo'm gu tukaa' gu chuukug; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' ka't cham tu' duu.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios cham gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu maa'nkar gu takarui' bɨɨx gu duukam jix buusñi gu Ejipto bɨɨx gu novɨ jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' tu duukam gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Jakob; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n dhi' gu ja'tkam tu' gu ux tu' uañi'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' cham gu suudai' gu oidha' pai' jix buusñi; na gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' gu oidha' ka't tu ñi'ook na gu' gu bhóogɨt jix buusñi na ba' kooda' pai' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu maa'nkar jix buusñi bɨɨx gu kavɨk bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook gu bhóogɨt gu jodai na ja'p tumiiñku jix tɨ'ɨ tu' gu kavɨk gu chuukug kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu u'u.
Jano' ba' ua'na' mii' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook mi'p gu bhóogɨt tumiiñku gu chuukug; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu u'u gu jodai' tu juan gook gu bhóogɨt gu jodai na ja'p tumiiñku jix tɨ'ɨ gu kavɨk bɨɨx gook gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' ua'na gu bhóogɨt jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu'p mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu kavɨk tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai gu tanoolh gu vaak; gio ba' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kavɨk gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ka't gu ñi'ook; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Beerot-bene-jakaam gu Moseraa; gio ba' jix koi gu Aaroon ka't jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr pai' gu kutun jix duñia' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu mar gu Eleasar.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Gudgod gu Jotbat gu oidha' gu jodai' gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix ai'chdhix gu Jawatan Dios bopxi'ñ gu Lebii na ba' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu takarui' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu duu na ba' jix bhai' aa' gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu Lebii cham jix duñia' baasɨ'n tu' gu maa'nkar bɨɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' tu' gu chuukug gu kavɨk na ja'p dharka' gu tanoolh oo'm gu tanoolh oo'm gu tukaa'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix kai gio dhi' jix duñia' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bamii' jiim na ba' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam na ba' kapbhai' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu oidha' gu takarui' tattat ka't gu chuukug.

Jano' ba' jano' gu Israeel gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook jum i'obh gu Jawatan Dios jiim bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ.
Na nukadham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ñi'ook kavɨk tu' gu o'o gu ñi'ook na ba' cham tu'x jai'ch xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' gu oidha' bɨx tu'x cham tu'x jai'ch.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tattat jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' xoi'kam jix duñia' gu kai' mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam na ja'p dhi' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu Kirkunkidad gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ cham gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai'.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' jix bhɨɨ gu oi'ñga'n.
Na duñia' bɨx bhai' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam; na xoi'kam gio ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' tɨi'chu'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr; na gu' gu ñi'ook jix bɨɨx duu gu takarui' gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jum i'obh gu bhóogɨt tu' gu chuukug gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' ñi'ook kavɨk aa'.
Jano' ba' gu kutun gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook bɨndak dhi' gu o'o tu'x gu vupui jix duñia' buupui.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu vaak gu i'ii'ñ jix dhaav tattat gu Ejipto; gio ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu si'avag gu tɨkɨr gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios nukadham jir bɨx bhai' ñi'ook kavɨk gu suudai' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jugi gu ñi'ook; na gu' cham chɨɨdaim bɨɨx gu ma'nkam cham jix duñia' gu jodai' tu' buupui sɨlhka'n gu Jawatan Dios gu duukam gu novɨ jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu buimɨk buimɨi tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Ejipto gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto bɨx gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' jix duu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Ejipto kavaayo gu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook jix duu gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook bhaan na pai' dhuuk aajidha' bhaan mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia' gu ñi'ook dhi' pai'.

Jano' ba' jix duu bɨɨx gu Dataan gu Abiram gu ma'nkam gu Eliab gu mar gu Rubeen; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix kupi'ook gu oidha' gu chin jix duñia' gu vaak vaak zel bɨx gu i'ii'ñ ko'kmarak tɨɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu Israeel.
Gu' gu' gu vupui jix duñia' buupui bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' nukadham bɨx gu ñi'ook tu' gu o'o gu ñi'ook na ba' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kapbhai' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu oidha' gu suudai' na ba' bia'ka'.
Jano' ba' na ba' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh bhaan gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tattat ka't gu chuukug gu kai' gu oidha' gu takarui' bii'm gu ñi'ook.
Na gu oidha' gu oi'ñga'n na ba' bia'ka' cham na ja'p gu oidha' gu Ejipto pai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook pai' gu chuukug gu kai' jix suudai' duu bɨɨx tɨɨt na ja'p u'uu pai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' gu suudai' na ba' bia'ka' gu oidha' gu kakkavɨk gu jodai'; gio ba' dhuuk gu tɨkɨr tu' i'i gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' bɨɨx tas bhaan gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios dɨr bɨɨpɨ' oi'ñga' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook tu' gu o'o gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu suudai' dhuuk gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu chuukug kai'ñ suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gio gu vaas yooxi' na ba' gu vaakax; gio ba' jugi tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ cham gu chuukug gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt i'iich gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu tɨkɨr cham ka't dhuuk tu' gu oidha' jix maa gu i'bhɨ gu ñi'ook jootom jix bhai' gu oidha' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios.
Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' jix duñia' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu ux nɨi'ñchudat gu novɨ ka't gu ux gu jodai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vupui.
Na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam a'gi'ñchu' gu jodai' daakat gu vaak jiim gu ux gu bhóogɨt na pai' dhuuk tu' gu takarui' na pai' dhuuk tu' jix búup.
Jano' ba' gu o'o gu maa'nkar gu vaak gu jodai'.
Na ba' na ba' ka't gu bhóogɨt gu tanoolh gu ma'nkam bhaan gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tattat ka't gu chuukug na ja'p gu tanoolh gu tɨkɨr bhaan gu oidha'.
Na gu' na gu' tu' nukadham gu ñi'ook bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook tu' gu o'o na ba' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' na ja'p gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gio mi'x juu'ñ bɨx dhi' chɨbɨɨp vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook chɨbɨɨp gu oi'ñga'n jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨx pai' gu oi'ñga'n gu vaas tɨɨt ka't; gio ba' dɨr oidha' jix gaki gu ñi'ook dɨr gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Euprates bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' soo'mchulhdhak gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ɨɨbhi'ñ choo'n gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu vupui bɨx gu oidha' gu jodai' na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu takarui' gu ñi'ook mu'ai.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu o'o gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' mu'ai tu' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook na ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham jix duñia' gu tasi'.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu suudai' gu oidha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' bia'ka' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook bhaan gu kavɨk gu Gerisim mu'ai bhaan gu kavɨk gu Ebal.
Jano' ba' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan bhaan gu bhóogɨt tas gei'ñ gu oidha' gu Kananeo jix daa vaak ja'tkam vupui bhaan gu Gilgal ju'ñdharan gu bhóogɨt gu More.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu Jordaan na ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix daa.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu takarui' gu ux tu duukam bɨx ñi'ook kavɨk gu suudai' tu' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam ñi'ook kavɨk gu suudai' jix duñia' gu takarui' gu ux tu duukam gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tattat tu' jix maa na ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu tanoolh gu takarui' gu chuukug bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu Destruiraan jix duñia' bɨx pai' chɨbɨɨp gu takarui' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu kakkavɨk gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ja'tkam bɨtaa'n bɨx gu u'u gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix duñia' gu chuukug gu jodai' gu takarui' bɨɨx gu tai; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr pai'.
Jano' ba' cham jix duu gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' pai' gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' bɨx bopxi'ñ na ba' jix dhaas gu tɨɨgɨ' na ba' ba'bhak gu chuukug jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' maa'nkar tai bhaan makgɨrxi'ñdha' boosgi gu maa'nkar gu jodai' gu noobh gu oi'ñga'n maa'nkar na jix maa gu chuukug gu jodai' kakneer.
Jano' ba' jugi vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu takarui' gu jodai' bɨx gu suudai' gu noobh gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' cham jix duu na ja'p bɨx no'ch gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jano' maa'n gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu suudai' bɨɨx ka'm jano' cham jix duñia' kia'mi'ñ jɨɨpi'ñka' gu maa'nkar jix maa gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan jix daa gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu ñi'ook maa'n jɨɨpi'ñka' bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ xikoolh jix daa gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' pai' gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' na ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' jix duñia' bɨx tu'x tu' gu takarui'; gio ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan makgɨrxi'ñdha' boosgi maa'nkar na jix maa gu oi'ñga'n gu noobh bɨx gu tasi' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ tu duukam gu Lebita gu takarui'; na gu' cham juraa'n baasɨ'n tu' gu maa'nkar bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook cham gu oi'ñga'n maa'nkar tai bhaan gu chuukug pai' jix duñia'.
Gu' gu' pai' gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' bopxi'ñ gu jodai' maa'nkar tai bhaan jix duu bɨx tu' gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx gu kutun kooda' jugi gu chuukug bɨx gu takarui' jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu oi'ñga'n jix maa; gio ba' ñaanbi' na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu takarui' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ɨ'ɨr cham jugi; gio ba' bhaan gu oidha' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' tu' gu kutun jugi gu takarui' mambhɨɨx kai'ñ suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu' tu' gu jodai' tu' kakneer tu' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' tu' maa'nkar na jix maa gu chuukug tu' gu oi'ñga'n maa'nkar na jix maa gu noobh.

Gu' gu' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' jugi pai' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu tasi' tu' gu mar mar u'vɨ tu duukam gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu Lebita gu takarui'; gio ba' tu' gu jodai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu suudai' gu noobh.
Jano' ba' mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook cham gu takarui' gu Lebita bɨx gu tanoolh bhaan gu oidha'.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' gu ñi'ook na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook tu' gu chuukug jugi gu chuukug na gu' jix duu gu i'ii'ñ jugi jurtu'nka' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ jugi gu chuukug.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' tu' pai' gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n gu tasi' na ba' jix dhaas gu tɨɨgɨ' koo'nda' gu jodai' kakneer gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't jix maa na ja'p tu' jix aa'ñdhix tu' jugi kiki'ñgob bhaan bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' jugi gu takarui' gu ñi'ook jugi; gio ba' ñaanbi' na jix bhai' jugi gio.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' gu takarui' cham jugi gu ɨ'ɨr; na gu' gu ɨ'ɨr gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr cham jugi gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨma'n bɨɨx gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' cham jugi; gio ba' gu oidha' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim na ja'p gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' cham jugi; na pai' dhuuk na ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook tu' gu ma'nkam mi' dhɨr tu' na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n jix bhɨɨ ɨlhdham pai' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu tasi'.

Jano' ba' gu jodai' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu chuukug gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ɨ'ɨr makgɨrxi'ñdha' ka't gu oi'ñga'n bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jugi gu chuukug.

Na pai' dhuuk jix nukadham gu chuukug bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook tu' gu takarui' na gu' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook tu' gu ma'nkam mi' dhɨr tu' na ba' bɨɨx tas na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook jix bhai' gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk ka't gu suudai' vupui bhaan tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' gu ja'tkam pai' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' bia'ka' gu ñi'ook jix daa gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook mi' dhɨr ka't gu suudai' vupui bhaan tu'; gio ba' cham tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham; mi' dhɨr tu juan mii' dhɨr chɨbɨɨp gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt tu' gio.
Jano' ba' cham jix duu gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' bɨx gu Jawatan Dios bhaamki'ñ jix duu gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu suudai' gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu ñi'ook gu tai gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' duñia' bɨx tu' gu takarui'; gio ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ tu' gu jodai' gu i'ii'ñ.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu chuukug tɨɨtki' tu' jix maa nɨi'ñchudat gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook nɨi'ñchudat gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tu' bham; gio ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' cham maa'n naak gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tu' jix duñia' gu chuukug tɨɨtki'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar na ba' maachim tu' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ nukadham gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu chuukug tɨɨtki' tu' gu suudai' jix koi; na gu' jix duñia' uañi'ñ bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto tu' jix duñia' gu vaak tu duukam mi'x juu'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix aa'ñdhix gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr gu jodai' cham bhai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk tu' gu chuukug xibhɨk gu mar gu naan gu mar mar u'vɨ gu u'vɨ baaso gu ja'tkam ka't na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ bham ɨxchuixim; gio ba' gu chuukug gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' tattat jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam xikoolh mia'n tu' gu suudai' tu' dɨr gu maa'nkar gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx tu' maa'n naak; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook uañi'ñka' tu' gu oi'ñga'n jugi tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' va'k kooda'; gio ba' gu novɨ ka't maa'n bhaan na ba' mu'aa' mi' dhɨr gu novɨ bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug bɨɨx gu jodai koi; na gu' jix duñia' gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu vaak tu duukam.
Na ba' na ba' bɨx gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu Tema cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ nɨidhim dhi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa na ba' jix koi tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu ux jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' jix duñia' gu jodai' jix koi kiicham bham; gio ba' gu chuukug gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' cham jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug tu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'r gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhuu jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' jix bhai'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu kuchii jix koi mii' dhɨr kiicham gu takarui' bɨɨx bɨx ka't gio gu vaakax gu bhóogɨt gu kuchii.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu takarui' tɨjɨɨ'ñ ɨrban gu chuukug bɨɨx gu tai kiicham bɨx gu takarui' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ka't gɨ' kavɨk na ba' bɨɨx tas; mi' dhɨr cham pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios dɨlhkob i'iich daak tu' jix maa gu ñi'ook jix duñia' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu' gu suudai' na ja'p jix duñia' tattat.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios nukadham bɨx gu ñi'ook tu' gu o'o gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham jix duñia' tu' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ bhaan gu vupui gu ux jix koi.
Na gu' na gu' gu chuukug gu ja'tkam jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tasi' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu jodai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam bhaan gu vupui gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' cham tu' jix bhai'x jugi.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu vaakax jugi; gio ba' gu vaakax kaneer gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ chiiw dodhia' maa'n gu vaakax dodhia' chiiw gɨ' kavɨk.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu vaakax gu ñi'ook juraa'n gu ja'tkam gook gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaakax gu takarui' jugi.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook dhi' ja'tkam cham jugi gu chuukug namki' gu ñi'ook gu takarui'; na gu' jix ai gu ñi'ook gu tasi' na gu' gu chuukug gu' cham namki' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' ka't jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu' juraa'n gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't ñaanbi'; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug suulhgia' cham jugi tu' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug koko'kam.
Jano' ba' dhi' jugi bɨx gu suudai'; gio ba' bɨx juraa'n gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt jugi.
Gu' gu' bɨx cham jix duñia' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt cham jugi; gio ba' ñaanbi' ka't.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu u'uvhig na jix bhai' jugi.
Jano' ba' dhi' cham jugi; gio ba' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Asor gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu kutun bhaan na jax chu'm.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook bhaan na jax chu'm.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu chuukug gu ñi'ook bhaan na jax chu'm.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook bhaan na jax chu'm gu bhóogɨt gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ko'oi gu oi'ñga'n ka't ñaanbi'; gio ba' cham jugi.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu u'uvhig na jix bhai' jugi.

Jano' ba' matgɨm gu ñi'ook jix koi jugi; gio ba' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu takarui' maa'n jugi; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n ja'tkam mii' dhɨr; na gu' tu' gu chuukug gu ja'tkam jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt bii'm gu naan.
Jano' ba' jix bhai'x mambhɨɨx bɨx gu maa'nkar gu kai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ yooxi' oi'ñga'.

Jano' ba' jugi vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios pai' gu takarui' na ba' gu vupui gu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' mambhɨɨx kai'ñ suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu' gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n gu vaakax na ba' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu tanoolh.

Na pai' dhuuk tu' gu bhóogɨt ka't gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tu' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug jix duñia' tu' pai' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu tasi' na ba' jix dhaas gu tɨɨgɨ' na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' bi'iix gu chuukug tuumiñ gu novɨ ɨlhdham pai' gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' maa'n tuumiñ gu ux bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu i'ii'ñ gu ux gu jodai' gu ux kakneer gu ux suudai' u'va gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu i'ii'ñ tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' jugi vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu jodai' tu' ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' cham gu chuukug gu Lebita jix duñia' gu takarui'; na gu' cham juraa'n baasɨ'n tu' gu maa'nkar bɨndak.
Jano' ba' gu maa'nkar vaik gu takarui' jix buusñi bɨx mambhɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n mii' dhɨr oi'ñga' nukadham jɨ'dɨlh.

Jano' ba' ɨlhdham gu Lebita cham juraa'n baasɨ'n tu' gu maa'nkar bɨndak ja'tkam mii' dhɨr ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam ka't gu takarui' jugi ka't gu takarui'; na ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu jodai' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu noobh gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu maa'nkar kɨɨv gu takarui' jix duu gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' dhi' gu jodai'; gio ba' uañi'ñka' gu suudai' bɨx gu bhóogɨt jix duu gu suudai' gu novɨ bɨɨx jix duñia' tɨtmo; mi' dhɨr cham jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n tɨtmo xibhɨk; na gu' gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt; gu' xibhɨk jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n uañi'ñka' gu novɨ.
Na ba' na ba' cham ka't tu' gu suudai'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix bhai' aa' bɨɨx gu tasi' gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa gu ux gu maa'nkar na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' cham gu ñi'ook gu suudai' jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' nukadham gu oi'ñga'n bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook.

Na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook gu takarui' jano' ba' mumua'da' chɨbɨɨp gu' tu' cham jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' gu gɨ'kora' mumua'da' chɨbɨɨp gu' tu' cham jix duñia'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk ka't tu' gu ja'tkam oi'ñdha' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa cham gu oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ tu' jix kup gu novɨ xibhɨk gampai'.
Gu' gu' bhi'spio'kai gu novɨ jix bhai'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' jix duñia' ka't gu chuukug.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook cham ka't gu i'ii'ñ jix bhai'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bham; gio ba' mia'n oi'ñga' kɨɨv gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr gu vupui ka't gu bhóogɨt bhaan xibhɨk gu ja'tkam na ba' cham nukadham; na gu kutun tu ñi'ook bhaan tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' uañi'ñ.
Na pai' dhuuk cham uañi'ñ maa'n cham ka't gu i'ii'ñ gu bhóogɨt na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug; na gu ux gu i'ii'ñ tu' jix bhai' aa' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu ñi'ook bɨx gu chuukug gu novɨ.
Na gu' na gu' cham jix duñia' gu ja'tkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha'; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook tu' gu takarui' bham; mi' dhɨr bhi'spio'kai gu novɨ xibhɨk gampai' gu ja'tkam gu oidha'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' xibhɨk gu ebreo gu ebrea tu' ka't jix duñia' gu ux gu takarui' kɨɨv oi'ñga' gu chuukug namkidhat tu'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n namkidhat tu' cham gu oi'ñga'n cham tu'x jai'ch.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai'x kakneer ka't gu chuukug; gio ba' maa'n mii' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook tu duukam gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia'; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' tu' gu takarui' dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu takarui'; gio ba' cham gu jodai' bɨndak; na gu' tu' xoi'kam tu' gu vaak tu' xoi'kam bɨndak.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu suudai' gu takarui' naak ju'ñdharan ki'ñgob ka't tu duukam na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' gio jix duu gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk cham tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai'x na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook namkidhat tu'; na gu maa'nkar gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu chuukug tu' jix duñia' gu ux gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix bhai' aa' bɨx gu jodai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu chio'ñ gu jodai' kakneer; gio ba' cham tu' gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' tu' bhaan gu oi'ñga'n kakneer.
Jano' ba' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' jugi oi'ñga' tu' ja'tkam vaak pai' gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' tu' ka't gu oi'ñga'n bai'ñchu' jix bhai'x no'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ uañi'ñ cham maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' jugi; gio ba' ñaanbi' na jix bhai' jugi na ja'p gu takarui' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' cham gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr; gio ba' bhaan gu oidha' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim na ja'p gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' nukadham gu takarui' gu Abib jix duu gakdhi'ñchix gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu takarui' gu Abib tu' jix buusñi gu Jawatan Dios gu Ejipto gu tukaa'.
Jano' ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gakdhi'ñchix gu Jawatan Dios kakneer gu jodai' pai' gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' na ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Jano' ba' cham jugi bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n; na gu' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jugi bɨɨx gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu takarui' gu jodai' na gu' jix duñia' gu takarui' gu oidha' gu Ejipto; na ba' tu' gu chuukug gu tanoolh gu takarui' gu oidha' gu Ejipto bɨx gu tanoolh pai'.
Jano' ba' cham kiicha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jabka' bɨndak bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ux kɨɨv gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu chuukug gu jodai' gu xumai maa'n gu tanoolh cham jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh.
Jano' ba' cham gu kutun gu vaak na jix bhai' gakdhi'ñchix matgɨm jɨ'dɨlh gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa.
Gu' gu ñi'ook pai' gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' na ba' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gakdhi'ñchix gu ux gu xumai jix duñia' gu tas gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jugi pai' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu tasi'; gio ba' gu ux gu xibh tu' jix maat gu bhóogɨt jix koi.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu tanoolh jugi gu chuukug kɨɨv gu tanoolh ka't jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham jix duu gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu chuukug tu' gu suudai'; gio ba' dɨr jugi gu jodai' gu novɨ kua'da' gu ñi'ook kɨɨv gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix duñia' gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu novɨ ka't gu chuukug bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' tu' gu jodai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu mar mar u'vɨ tu duukam gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu Lebita jɨ'dɨlh ja'tkam mii' dhɨr ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' pai' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu tasi' na ba' gu vupui gu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook tu duukam gu Ejipto; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' nukadham gu ñi'ook dhi' ja'tkam ñi'ook kavɨk.
Na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu kutun jix duu gu ux kɨɨv gu tanoolh na pai' dhuuk cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook gu ux na tu ibai' ka't gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' tu' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook tu' gu mar mar u'vɨ tu duukam gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu Lebita ja'tkam mii' dhɨr ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh gu chuukug jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios pai' gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui'; na gu' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu i'bhɨ bɨx gu ñi'ook gu noobh dhi' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x.

Jano' ba' gu Tres mui'kim oi'ñga' gu suudai' bɨx gu chio'ñ gu oi'ñga'n vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios pai' gu takarui'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu chuukug jix duñia' gu chuukug jix duñia' gu kutun; mi' dhɨr cham gu suudai' cham tu'x jai'ch vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' maa'n bɨɨx gu duukam gu novɨ jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't jix maa.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu bhóogɨt bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu Jawatan Dios tu' maa'n bopxi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bɨɨx jir bhai' ñi'ook na jir bhai'.

Jano' ba' cham gu jodai' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu duukam gu bhóogɨt tu' jix bhɨɨ gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ; na gu' gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu vupui mamatdagɨm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jir bhai' ja'tkam.
Na gu' bɨx bhai' gu suudai' na gu' na jix do'ig gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa.
Jano' ba' cham tu' gu ux na tu ibai' gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu u'u mia'n jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n dhi'; gio ba' bhaamki'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu vaakax mar kaneer ka't uañi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ ka't gu ñi'ook cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios bhaan ñi'ook na jix bhaan.
Na ka't gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu tas gu masad bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tɨkɨr tu' cham jix aa'ñdhix.
Jano' ba' tu' ka't jix maa aa'ñdham mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt cham tu'x jai'ch gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook tu'r dhuu jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' jix duñia' gu kutun gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix buusñi gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ ka't gu ñi'ook dhi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kiki'ñgob gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ gu jodai' na jix uam bɨɨx gu jodai koi.
Jano' ba' gu ux tu ñi'ook gook gu tasi' vaik gu tasi' koi ka't koi; gio ba' cham koi gu ux tu ñi'ook gu duukam gu tasi'.
Jano' ba' gu novɨ gu tasi' ka't maa'n bhaan na ba' kooda' mi' dhɨr gu novɨ bɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu jodai' cham bhai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' ka't gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jir bhai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ɨ'ɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ kuiñcha tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu jiim gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n jɨ'dɨlh; gio ba' jano' ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' pai' gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' ɨlhdham jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas jir bɨx bhai' ka't mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu chuukug ñi'ook na jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu bhaan gu chuukug tu' gu takarui' pai' gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' gu chuukug duñia' bhaan bɨx tu' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' bhaan ñi'ook na tu a'ga tu' jix maat bhaan ñi'ook na jir bhai' tu' gu suudai' jix duu; gio ba' cham tu' gu bhóogɨt tu' kɨɨ'n tu' gu jodai' gu chuukug tu' gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu ux cham gu jodai' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jir bɨx bhai' jix duñia' gu chio'ñ koi; gio ba' gu jodai' cham bhai' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk cham tu'x jai'ch kia'mi'ñ gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa gu vupui jix daa gu chuukug; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora' bhaan tu' na ja'p bɨx chɨbɨɨp xikoolh.

Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu gɨ'kora' bhaan tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui'; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora' bhaan tu'; mi' dhɨr cham gu kutun jix dhaas bhaan tu' gu chio'ñ ja'tkam mii' dhɨr cham ka't xibhɨk.

Gu' cham gu ñi'ook cham jix bhai'x kavaayo tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu Ejipto na ba' gu takarui' kavaayo; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook dhi' gu bhóogɨt.
Na gu' tu' jix duñia' na ba' gu u'vɨ na gu' gu i'ii'ñ cham gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' tu' jix toja jodai tu' jix uam jodai jix duñia' na ba' gu vaak.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' tu' gu ñi'ook na ba' u'uan bhaan dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu takarui' vupui bhaan jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas.

Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n baidhak gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha' na ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' nukadham bɨx gu ñi'ook gu chuukug ñi'ook na tu a'ga dhi' ja'tkam ñi'ook kavɨk na ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu duukam.
Na ba' na ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ bhaan gu ja'tkam tu' dɨlhkob gu ñi'ook kɨɨ'n tu' gu jodai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu tanoolh oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Lebii cham jix duñia' baasɨ'n tu' gu maa'nkar bɨɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar jugi.
Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' gu maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dhi' ka't gu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan baasɨ'n gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu vaakax mar kaneer; gio ba' jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' kai'ñ suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu' gu takarui' gu i'ii'ñ kakneer maa'n.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tasi' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx bopxi'ñ na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Lebita gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh bɨx gu Israeel pai' ka't gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ pai' gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p bɨx xibhɨk gu Lebitas vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu maa'nkar na ja'p gu maa'nkar jugi gu suudai'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk cham tu'x jai'ch kia'mi'ñ gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa cham gu takarui' bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mii' dhɨr chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' cham ka't gaagam tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu mar mar u'vɨ gu ux gu tai tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' tu' gu bhóogɨt tu' gu bhóogɨt tu' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' tu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n tu' jix duñia' tu' koko'kam.
Na gu' na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios no'x duñia' dhi' tu'x gu ux dhi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' mi'x juu'ñ vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka' bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' dhi' chɨbɨɨp gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt; gu' tu' cham tu' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu ja'tkam na ja'p tu' jix búup gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' jurtu'nka' bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu oreb gu tanoolh gu vaak bham; na gu' cham jix duñia' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu chuukug tu' gu oi'ñga'n dhi' gu tai na gu' cham gu jodai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu jodai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam na ja'p tu'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu chin tu ñi'ook bɨx tu' jix aa'ñdhix.
Gu' gu' ka't no'x cham gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' gu takarui'.

Gu' cham gu ñi'ook jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu takarui' ñiokda' gu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' cham ka't jix aa'ñdhix ñiokda' tu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan koi.
Jano' ba' tu' gu chuukug gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham ka't tu ñi'ook.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios cham ka't jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham tu'; gio ba' bɨɨx gu ux tu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; mi' dhɨr cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ choo'n.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' chɨbɨɨp gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa tu' gu ñi'ook jix daa jɨ'dɨlh gu vaak.
Jano' ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt vaik jɨ'dɨlh tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt vaik gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' maa'n gu maa'nkar ka't na ba' bɨx mua'kam gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mua'kam tu' gu takarui' ii'mdagaram; na gu chuukug tɨtmo gu i'ii'ñ gu vaak cham ga'ra' gu jodai' dɨr gu ñi'ook tu' va'k gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' na ja'p ka't bɨɨx tɨtmo gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu u'u gu takarui' gu kavɨk bɨɨx gu novɨ gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook gu kutun gu chuukug jix duñia' jix kavɨk jodai gu maa'nkar jix duñia' tɨtmo jix koi; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu suudai' jɨ'dɨlh ii'mdagaram.

Na pai' dhuuk cham ka't jir bɨx bhai' jix koi gu oi'ñga'n bhaan mua'kam na pai' dhuuk gu takarui' gu i'ii'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ gu suudai' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n koi'm cham gu suudai' gu ux koi'm; na gu' cham ga'ra' gu jodai' dɨr gu ñi'ook tu' va'k gu ñi'ook bɨɨx jix koi.
Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' tu' gu takarui' bham; gio ba' vaik jɨ'dɨlh tu' gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu ñi'ook tattat tu' jix maa bɨx gu oidha' tattat ka't gu chuukug.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk nuuka'n bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook tu' gu o'o gu ñi'ook na ba' jix duñia' gu ux tu duukam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu tanoolh; gio ba' jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n vaik jɨ'dɨlh gu oi'ñga'n dhi' vaik.
Na gu' na gu' cham ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu ɨ'ɨr gu tasi' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa gu ux gu maa'nkar ka't bhaan tu' gu ɨ'ɨr.
Na pai' dhuuk gu' na pai' dhuuk ka't oi'ñdha' gu oi'ñga'n tɨtmo gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' bhaan gu chuukug koi'm gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook dhi' jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' daraa kiicham gu ñi'ook jix duñia' kapbhai' gu novɨ jir bɨx bhai' jix koi koi.
Jano' ba' cham uañi'ñka' gu vupui; gio ba' gu jodai' gu Israeel gu ɨ'ɨr gu tasi' tu' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' cham gu jodai' gu ñi'ook tɨtmo nɨi'ñchudat gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu vupui gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham gu takarui' gu tasi' bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu suudai' gu chuukug uañi'ñ gu chuukug uañi'ñ jugi; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gook gu tasi' vaik gu tasi' gu suudai' gu chuukug.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu tasi' ɨɨxi'ñdha' bhaan oi'ñdha' na ba' gu suudai' bhaan uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gook gu chichio'ñ gu chuukug jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu bhóogɨt ka't mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu tasi' ɨɨxi'ñdha' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam bhaan xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' jix duu na ja'p jix duñia' duñia' xibhɨk; gio ba' gu jodai' cham bhai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook cham gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ja'p gu chuukug tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' cham uañi'ñka' gu vupui; gio ba' gu oidha' gu ux gu oidha' gu vupui gu ux gu vupui taatam gu ux taatam gu novɨ gu ux gu novɨ tɨɨt gu ux tɨɨt.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu bhóogɨt bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' kavaayo gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n jix gɨ' tu' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ choo'n gu Jawatan Dios bɨndak tu' jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug na ba' jugi jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug; gio ba' gu takarui' gu Israeel gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr cham gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ cham gu takarui' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu suudai' vupui bhaan.
Na gu Jawatan Dios jiim bɨɨx gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ na ba' dodhia'.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bham; na gu' chɨkka tu' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu ja'tkam cham tu' gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' gu vaak na gu' gu kutun cham gu jodai' gu chuukug oi'ñdha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Na gu' chɨkka tu' gu ux na tu ibai' oidha' u'va cham tu' gu ñi'ook kua'dam gu tasi' gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' gu vaak na gu' gu kutun cham gu jodai' gu chuukug oi'ñdha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Na gu' chɨkka tu' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu u'vɨ cham tu' jix bhɨɨ gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' gu vaak na gu' gu kutun cham gu jodai' gu chuukug gu kutun jix bhɨɨ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook ñiokda' gu ja'tkam gu chuukug; gio ba' chɨkka gu chio'ñ jix bhai'x gu i'ii'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' gu vaak cham gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ gu ja'tkam na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook ñiokda' gu ja'tkam jano' ba' gu ñi'ook chugi'ñ jix aa'ñdhix vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk tu' gu oi'ñga'n kiicham na ba' jugi gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' tu ñi'ook bhai'x i'ii'ñ tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't gaagam tu' ka't bopxi'ñ tu' tu juan.
Gu' gu' tu' cham gu oi'ñga'n bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨndak gu chuukug bɨndak bhɨɨ'ñdham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' kapbhai' gu novɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu chio'ñ gu kutun gu bhóogɨt gu kuchii.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu u'vɨ a'aalh gu vaakax bɨx ka't kiicham bɨx gu takarui' jix bhɨɨ na ba' tu'; gio ba' jugi gu takarui' obhɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' do'ñcho.
Jano' ba' jix duu bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' tu' cham ka't jɨ'dɨlh dhi' chɨbɨɨp.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh dhi' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa gu ux gu maa'nkar matgɨm gu ñi'ook kiicha' bɨɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' va'k bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu takarui' gu Amorreo gu Kananeo gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Jebuseo; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix aa'ñdhix.
Na gu' na gu' cham jix maat duñia' bhaan bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug jix duñia' gu ñi'ook kiicham gu ux bhaan mui'x gu tanoolh na ba' jix bhɨɨ cham gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook na gu' jugi; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook cham gu chio'ñ gu u'u yooxi' na ba' jix ai bhaan tu' jix duñia'.
Gu' gu' gu u'u gu ñi'ook cham gu u'u na ba' jugi gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu duukam bhaan kiicham gu bhóogɨt bɨndak bɨɨx ka'm jix gɨ'kora'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk ka't gaagam gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa na ba' gu ñi'ook jix koi baas yooxi' cham gu oi'ñga'n chɨkka naaka'n.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' daraa gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm jɨ'dɨlh xikoolh jix koi.
Jano' ba' ka't daraa mii' dhɨr kiicham gu oi'ñga'n mia'n jix koi jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook cham ka't jix duñia' cham ka't gu jodai' gu tasi'.
Jano' ba' daraa mii' dhɨr kiicham gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu suudai' jix bhai'x cham pai' dhuuk ka't jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ tu' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu suudai'.

Na gu' jano' ba' aajim jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ma'nkam gu Lebii na gu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu suudai' na ba' jix bhai' aa' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ux tu ñi'ook jix duñia' bɨx gu ñi'ook bɨx tu jiim.
Jano' ba' bɨx daraa mii' dhɨr kiicham gu oi'ñga'n mia'n jix koi jix duñia' gu noobh bhaan gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu chuukug; gio ba' gu novɨ gu noobh cham jix duñia' vaak na jix bhaan dhi' gu ɨ'ɨr tu' gu novɨ gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu Israeel gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu bhóogɨt gu ɨ'ɨr gu tasi' gu oi'ñga'n tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu ɨ'ɨr ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Na pai' dhuuk tu' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr gu tasi' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu bhóogɨt bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' kapbhai' gu novɨ jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ gu takarui' gu suudai' jix bhɨɨ na ba' tu' gu ux gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak; gio ba' gu suudai' mo'o jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' tɨi'chu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu vaak; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu taat gu naan gu ñi'ook gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr ba'k ka' gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' cham tu' gu chuukug mi'x dhaas gu bhóogɨt; na gu' cham bi'iix gu ux tuumiñ tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx na gu' gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu chio'ñ jix duñia' gook gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu jodai' gu ma'nkam gu mar maa'nkam mar ka't gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tanoolh gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook maraa'n jix duñia' cham gu kutun gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu mar gu chuukug maa'nkam mar.
Gu' gu' gu mar gu chuukug gu takarui' gu ux maa'nkam mar na ba' jix maa gook gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu ñi'ook juraa'n; na gu' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨpɨ' gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu kutun.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' jix duñia' gu mar gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu taat tu' gu ñi'ook gu naan gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt cham gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu taat gu naan jix duñia' daraa kiicham ki'ñgob pai' gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug daraa kiicham; gio ba' dhi' chulhiiñdha' gu mar gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham gu bhóogɨt gu kutun gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu jodai' gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' bɨx gu chichio'ñ kiicham jix duñia' bɨɨx gu jodai koi; gio ba' gu jodai' cham bhai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu Israeel gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' ka't uañi'ñ gu chuukug koi'm gu ñi'ook ka't koi gu oi'ñga'n jix duu.

Na gu' cham jix duñia' gu chuukug gu ux gu tukaa' jix duu gu' cham uañi'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu tanoolh na gu' mu'ai gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa gu ux gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu vaakax xibhɨk mar kaneer gu ñi'ook tu' gu takarui'; gio ba' jix bhai'x jix maat xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' tu' xibhɨk cham ka't gu chuukug cham gu chuukug gu suudai' gu vaak no'm bɨndak bɨɨx ka'm xibhɨk jix duñia' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gio tɨi'chu' bɨɨx bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n xibhɨk gu takarui' tu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu kutun gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook xibhɨk gu vaakax gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt tu' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' bɨɨx gu suudai' jix búup.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ gu vaak gu chio'ñ tu' gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ; na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios no'x dhi' duñia'.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu kutun gu ñi'ook gu u'uvhig gu chuukug gu u'u bhaan gu oidha' bɨɨx gu suudai' gu vaak gu naan mi'x juu'ñ bhaan gu suudai' bhaan gu vaak cham jix bhɨɨ gu naan bɨɨx gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' kiicha' tu' gu naan jix bhɨɨ gu suudai' na ba' tu'; na ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu ja'tkam jix duu gu ñi'ook gu tasi' na gu' cham gu chuukug gu ɨ'ɨr gu vaak tu' jix duñia' oi'ñdha'.
Na gu' cham gu ñi'ook oidha' u'va gu jodai' gu kai' na gu' cham gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu takarui' gu kai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu i'bhɨ oidha' u'va.
Jano' ba' cham gu jodai' bɨɨx gu vaakax bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨɨma'n.
Jano' ba' cham tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu jodai' bɨɨma'n.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duu gu jodai' maakobh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' bɨɨx tu' gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ mi' dhɨr gu suudai' kia'mi'ñ gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu takarui'; gio ba' dhi' jix bhɨɨ gu ux gu u'vɨ gu takarui' cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu taat gu bhóogɨt gu naan jix bhɨɨ jix duñia' buimɨk gu ñi'ook gu takarui' daraa kiicham ki'ñgob.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu taat gu bhóogɨt daraa; gio ba' tu' mar u'vɨ dhi' gu chio'ñ gu ux gu u'vɨ bhaamki'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix dhaas gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt tu'x bham; gio ba' cham gaagam mar u'vɨ gu ñi'ook; gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu suudai' buimɨk gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tasi' vupui bhaan daraa kiicham.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' daraa kiicham jix bhɨɨ gu chio'ñ jix duñia'.

Na gu' jix duñia' gu tasi' gu ñi'ook jix toja jodai jix duñia' gu taat gu bhóogɨt na gu' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' mambhɨɨx gu ux gu u'vɨ cham gu kutun gu ñi'ook bɨx gu tanoolh.
Gu' gu' tu' dhi' gu chuukug ka't tu'r cham ka't gaagam gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' ki'ñgob gu vaak gu taat jix duñia' bɨɨx gu jodai gu chichio'ñ kiicham koi; na gu' jix duu gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Israeel gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak gu taat; mi' dhɨr gu jodai' cham bhai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ oi'ñdha' baas bɨɨx gu u'vɨ gu takarui' bɨɨx gu chio'ñ ba'k koi gu chio'ñ jix duñia' bɨɨx gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu jodai' cham bhai' gu Israeel.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk ka't gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook bɨɨx oi'ñdha' gu ñi'ook kiicham mi'x juu'ñ bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob mii' dhɨr kiicham jix duñia' bɨɨx gu jodai koi; na gu' gu bhóogɨt na gu' cham jix maa jiiñak kiicham gu chio'ñ na gu' jix duñia' gu u'vɨ tɨtmo; mi' dhɨr gu jodai' cham bhai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Gu' gu' tu' gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook yooxi' gu jodai' mi'x juu'ñ bɨɨx koi gu oi'ñga'n gu chio'ñ bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n baas.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt cham jix duu cham tu'; gio ba' cham juraa'n gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook koi'm; na pai' dhuuk na gu' na ja'p na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' jix búup bhaan tɨtmo gu chuukug gu oidha' dhi'.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook yooxi'; gio ba' jix maa jiiñak gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook cham ka't gu oi'ñga'n.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook cham ka't gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ mi'x juu'ñ bɨɨx ka't bakia'.
Na gu' jano' ba' gu chio'ñ mi'x juu'ñ bɨɨx maa'n gu taat gu bhóogɨt mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix toja jodai ka't gu u'vɨ na gu' jix duñia'; gio ba' cham gu kutun gu takarui' bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' cham jix bhɨɨ oi'ñdha' gu u'vɨ gu taat tu' gu ñi'ook jix suudai' duu gu taat.
Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu suudai' tu' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' gu Ammonita tu' gu Moabita gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' bɨɨx tas.

Na pai' dhuuk na gu' cham moor gu takarui' bɨɨx gu takarui' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt na pai' dhuuk moor gu Ejipto; na gu' jix duñia' bhaan tu' gu Balaam gu mar gu Beor gu Petor gu suudai' gu ñi'ook na ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Gu' gu' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt gu Balaam; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' mu'ai gu oi'ñga'n na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' dha'da'.
Jano' ba' cham gu jodai' bhai'x i'ii'ñ tu' xoi'kam gu bhóogɨt gu tanoolh na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' cham gu takarui' gu suudai' xibhɨk; gio ba' cham gu takarui' gu Egipkio ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ gu oi'ñga'n jɨjɨkgɨm gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu bhóogɨt vaak ja'tkam bhaan gu takarui' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk ka't tu' oi'ñdha' cham ka't na jix bhai' gu ux gu tukaa' gu jodai' yooxi' cham jix duñia'.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu bhóogɨt gu xumai jix duñia' bɨɨx gu suudai' na pai' dhuuk ka't gu ñi'ook gu tas jix duñia' yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n pai' mai' vaak ja'tkam gu jodai' mai'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gio dhi' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook mai' gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt jix bhaan dhaas gu suudai'.

Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ yooxi' na ba' jix duñia' kɨɨsa' gu takarui' vupui bhaan tu'; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' ka't vaak ja'tkam jix bhaan; na gu' cham gu chuukug tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' cham kapbhai' gu Jawatan tu duukam gu bhóogɨt tu' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix koi bɨndak tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' pai' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh pai' xoi'kam; gio ba' cham jix duu gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n ganai' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Israeel tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' cham gu jodai' u'uuk ganai' tu' u'uuk gagai' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu tasi'; na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios maa'n na ja'p.
Jano' ba' cham jix bhɨɨ xibhɨk gu suudai' tuumiñ tu' gu suudai' jugi tu' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix bhɨɨ.
Na gu' gu tanoolh jix bhɨɨ gu suudai' gu' xibhɨk cham jix bhɨɨ na gu' tu' gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx tu duukam gu noobh bhaan gu oidha' gu oi'ñga'n na ba' bia'ka'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu bhóogɨt gu tasi' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu jodai' jix duñia'; na gu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' uañi'ñ.
Na pai' dhuuk gu' na pai' dhuuk tu' gu takarui' jix duñia' cham gu oi'ñga'n tu' uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' nukadham gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' jix duu na ja'p gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios aagak tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook gu chin.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n oidha' u'va tɨtmo jugi gu suudai' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; gu' cham gu bhóogɨt vaaso.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n gu ja'tkam tɨtmo gu kutun gu ñi'ook kaipgaidhat bɨɨx gu novɨ; gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu ja'tkam tɨtmo.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ gu chuukug bɨɨx tu' cham gu chuukug gu ux gu suudai' gaagam gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' gu ñi'ook kapbhai' gu novɨ gu takarui' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu kutun tu' gu jodai' bɨɨx gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu o'o gu ñi'ook kapbhai' gu novɨ gu jodai' gu vaak; gio ba' tu' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ jix bhɨɨ na ba' gu ux gu u'vɨ.

Jano' ba' cham gu kutun maa'n gu chio'ñ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ na ba' ka't gu u'vɨ mi' dhɨr ka't gu bhóogɨt; na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios cham gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa gu ux gu maa'nkar.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix bhɨɨ oi'ñdha' gu u'vɨ gu ja'tkam cham gu jodai' bhɨɨ'ñdham tu' matgɨm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia'; gio ba' namkidhat jix duñia' gu vaak gu ux oi'ñga' na ba' jix duñia' gu u'vɨ jix bhɨɨ.
Jano' ba' cham jix bhɨɨ gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' na jix uam tu' gu i'ii'ñ tu' jiix; na gu' gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk ka't gaagam oi'ñdha' ka't gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook xibhɨk gu ma'nkam gu Israeel ka't gu takarui' bɨɨx ka't jix duñia' ɨxkum koi gu jodai' cham bhai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu jiim dua'ñdha' gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ duñia' bhaan bɨx jix maat jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas; gio ba' jix duñia' duñia' na ja'p jix aa'ñdhix.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios gu Mariia gu bhóogɨt mi' dhɨr moor gu Ejipto.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug tɨtmo gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham ba'k gu vaak na ba' jix bhɨɨ gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' mai' dhi' gu chio'ñ jix duñia' tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' tu' ka't gu chio'ñ gampai' cham gu takarui' bɨɨx gu maa'nkar.
Na pai' dhuuk jix bhai'x gu suudai' gu maa'nkar na pai' dhuuk gu tas jix duñia' na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' gu jodai'; gio ba' tu' ka't bɨx bhai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu chuukug gampai' gu ja'tkam na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu oidha' jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh maa'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham gu bhóogɨt gu tas cham gu jodai'; na gu' gampai' bɨɨx jix duñia' gu oidha'; na gu' cham tu ñi'ook bhaan tu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu' uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' tattat cham koi gu ux gu ma'nkam tu' gu ma'nkam gu ux tattat; gio ba' maa'n koi gu ux uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' cham gu suudai' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam; gio ba' tu' jix bhɨɨ gu ux gu jodai' gu ñi'ook ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam.
Gu' gu' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook tu duukam gu Ejipto tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' tu' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook dhi'.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug gu ja'tkam yooxi' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu suudai' yooxi' cham jix maat jix bhɨɨ; na ba' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr na ba' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam na ba' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam ka't; na gu' tu' gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu ñi'ook gu noobh.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk tu jiim gu ñi'ook cham bɨx ja'k jiim mamraga'n bhaan tu'; na ba' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr na ba' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam na ba' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam ka't.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook oidha' u'va cham gu suudai' bhaan tu'; na ba' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr na ba' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam na ba' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam ka't.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook tu duukam gu oidha' gu Ejipto; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' tu' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook dhi'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk ka't gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhɨt gu bhóogɨt ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jir bhai' gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' jix duñia' jano' ba' jir bɨx bhai' jix duñia' mi'x juu'ñ gu oidha' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan bhaan gu suudai' gu ux jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu chuukug oo'm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' cham ka't tu' gu chuukug bɨɨx mui'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n suulhgia' gu oi'ñga'n xibhɨk vupui bhaan gu vupui.
Na pai' dhuuk cham gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu vaakax na pai' dhuuk jix duñia'.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu ja'tkam tɨtda:―Aañ gu jodai' oi'ñdha' cham jix duñia' gu mar gu u'vɨ jix koi cham jix duñia' mai' bɨɨx gu chio'ñ gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' jix duñia' jix bhɨɨ gu ux gu u'vɨ jix duñia' bɨɨx gu chuukug.
Na gu' ka't maa'nkam mar na ba' jix búup gu tɨɨgɨ' xibhɨk jix koi na gu' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ux cham ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' tu' gu chio'ñ cham gu bhóogɨt jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook jano' ba' gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' gu jodai' ki'ñgob daraa gu chuukug; gio ba' gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' cham gu suudai' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Israeel xibhɨk; mi' dhɨr cham gu suudai' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' daraa mii' dhɨr kiicham jix duu gu kutun tu ñi'ook bɨɨx; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu takarui' cham gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' jano' ba' gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' vupui bhaan daraa jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt tɨɨt tu jiim gu vupui tu ñi'ook gu chuukug; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ cham gu chuukug gu vaak xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't tɨɨgim gu Israeel; gio ba' gu vaak gu jodai'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk dhɨt gu oi'ñga'n tɨtda:―Aañ maa'n bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu u'vɨ maa'n na ba' jix duñia' gu chio'ñ gu novɨ gu chuukug gu suudai' gu novɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jano' ba' gu novɨ cham uañi'ñka' gu vupui.
Jano' ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n chu' gu oi'ñga'n jix gɨ' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak gu Epa jix gɨ' gu Epa jix ali'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx bhai' gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gu Epa jix duñia' jir bhai' gu oi'ñga'n; na ba' gu tanoolh ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa.
Na gu' na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios no'x duñia' dhi' no'x duñia' gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu takarui' tu' gu Amalek gu bhóogɨt na pai' dhuuk moor gu Ejipto.
Na pai' dhuuk tu' jix buus gu bhóogɨt tu' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu suudai' tu' na pai' dhuuk tu' dhi' jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' obhɨɨ'ñ xikoolh gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa gu ux gu maa'nkar na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨ'ñchoka' gu Amalek bɨtaa'n gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' cham tu' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk cham tu'x jai'ch kia'mi'ñ gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa gu ux gu maa'nkar gu vupui jix daa.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu takarui' bɨx gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' gu jodai' gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa gu bhóogɨt pai' gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ka't mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh daipu'; gio ba' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios kia'mi'ñ gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios taata'n tattat ka't gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix bhɨɨ gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook daipu' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu vaak gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix koi ka't gu taat jix dhaav gu Ejipto gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu vaak gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' jix kavɨk jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu Egipkios jix duñia' jix dhaas bhaan no'ch gu jodai' juantu'n.
Jano' ba' duuñ gu Jawatan Dios taata'n tattat; gio ba' jix kai gu Jawatan Dios gu kutun gu ñi'ook jix ñi' gu kutun gu jodai' chulhiiñdha' tu jiim gu kutun gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix buusñi gu Jawatan Dios gu Ejipto bɨɨx gu novɨ jix kavɨk bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx buimɨk bɨɨx gu ux.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ dhi' pai' jix maa dhi' gu oidha' gu takarui' bii'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' gu suudai' gu jodai' gu takarui' gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' chɨɨdak gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' kiicha' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu chuukug vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' gu jodai' bɨɨx bɨx xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't jix maa tu' gu vaak tu' gu Lebita ja'tkam mii' dhɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx bɨx mambhɨɨx gu i'bhɨ oi'ñga' vaik oi'ñga' mambhɨɨx maa'n gio gu Lebita ja'tkam mii' dhɨr ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam; gio ba' jugi gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' daipu' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Yo jix buusñi jix bhaan gu vaak gio jix maa gu Lebita ja'tkam mii' dhɨr ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam jurtu'nka' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr cham bhaan gu ñi'ook tu' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' cham jugi gu i'ii'ñ gu chuukug tu' jix buusñi gu i'ii'ñ gu vaak tu' gu i'ii'ñ jix maa na ba' jix koi; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' bɨx jix aa'ñdhix.
Jano' ba' tu jiim dɨr gu vaak na jix bhai' jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' dɨr gu tɨkɨr gu jodai' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel gu oidha' jix maa na ja'p gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ taata'n tattat gu oidha' gu takarui' bii'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' dhi' ja'tkam ñi'ook kavɨk gu suudai'; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu ux tu duukam bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook na ba' tu' ka't gu ux gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jiim gu bhóogɨt na ba' nukadham ñi'ook kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu suudai' na ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu ja'tkam na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook na ba' nukadham bɨx gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix duu na ba' gu takarui' jix bhai'x bhaan bɨx chɨbɨɨp na ba' gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gɇ'kamtu'nda'; gio ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees bɨɨx daraa gu Israeel gu ja'tkam bham; gio ba' nukadham bɨx gu ñi'ook tu' gu o'o gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tanoolh gu bhóogɨt gu Jordaan gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa tu' jix búup gu jodai gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu takarui'.

Na pai' dhuuk gu o'o bɨx gu ñi'ook dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga na pai' dhuuk cham tu'x jai'ch gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' baakɨi gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa gu oidha' gu takarui' bii'm gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tattat tu' tu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk cham tu'x jai'ch gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jordaan jix búup dhi' gu jodai tu' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu Ebal gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu jodai; gio ba' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan jix kavɨk jodai.
Jano' ba' gu jodai jix duñia' gu suudai' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu jodai' bhaan maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jugi; gio ba' tu' gu jodai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu o'o gu jodai bɨx gu ñi'ook dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu bhóogɨt gu duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees bɨɨx jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas bɨx gu Israeel bham; gio ba' gu jodai' gu chuukug gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees gu ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bham.

Na pai' dhuuk dhi' ja'tkam no'm bhaan gu kavɨk gu Gerisim na ba' jix bhai' aa' gu ja'tkam na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jordaan; gio ba' gu Simeoon gu Lebii gu Judaa gu Issakâr gu Josee gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam no'm na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mu'ai gu Ebal; gio ba' gu Rubeen gu Gad gu Aser gu ñi'ook gu Dan gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Lebitas gu chuukug bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Israeel gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu kutun gu chio'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak na jax chu'm gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu takarui' jix duñia' gu suudai'; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr gu Ameen.
Jano' ba' gu kutun gu ñi'ook gu taat gu naan; gio ba' gu chuukug bɨx gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu Ameen.
Jano' ba' gu kutun gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook tɨtmo; gio ba' gu chuukug bɨx gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu Ameen.
Jano' ba' gu kutun gu oi'ñga'n bai'ñchu' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu chuukug bɨx gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu Ameen.
Jano' ba' gu kutun gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook ja'tkam mii' dhɨr ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam; gio ba' gu chuukug bɨx gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu Ameen.
Jano' ba' gu kutun mi'x juu'ñ bɨɨx gu u'vɨ gu taat; na gu' jix ñi'ñ jix suudai' duu gu taat; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug bɨx gu ja'tkam; jano' ba' gu Ameen.
Jano' ba' gu kutun jix duñia' baasɨ'n bɨɨx no'x gu vaakax; gio ba' gu chuukug bɨx gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu Ameen.
Jano' ba' gu kutun mi'x juu'ñ bɨɨx gu ja'tkam mar u'vɨ gu taat mar u'vɨ gu naan; gio ba' gu chuukug bɨx gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu Ameen.
Jano' ba' gu kutun mi'x juu'ñ bɨɨx bakxidhat; gio ba' gu chuukug bɨx gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu Ameen.
Jano' ba' gu kutun gu chuukug tɨtmo jix bhai'x; gio ba' gu chuukug bɨx gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu Ameen.
Jano' ba' gu kutun gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu duukam na ba' gu ñi'ook koi'm gu tasi'; gio ba' gu chuukug bɨx gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu Ameen.
Jano' ba' gu kutun cham gu suudai' gu ñi'ook dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga na ba' gu ñi'ook na jix bhai'; gio ba' gu chuukug bɨx gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu Ameen.

Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' nukadham na ba' gu takarui' gu ux tu duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook tu' gu o'o gu ñi'ook gio gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x bhaan bɨx chɨbɨɨp gu oidha'.
Na pai' dhuuk aajim bhaan tu' bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' na pai' dhuuk gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' ka' tu' kiicham gu takarui' tu' yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu i'bhɨ vook gu i'bhɨ gu vaakax gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' kakneer.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' ka' baakɨi gu takarui' jix buus.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios obhɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' bhaan tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' vupui bhaan tu'; gio ba' gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook tu' gu ux kɨɨv gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bɨndak gu ñi'ook gu suudai' bɨx mii' dhɨr gu chuukug gu novɨ; gio ba' tu' jix bhai' aa' gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa.
Na pai' dhuuk tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu ja'tkam gu kutun jix bhaan na ja'p tu' gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk nukadham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios tɨɨgim bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios daam xoi'kam gu i'bhɨ vook gu i'bhɨ gu vaakax gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tattat tu' ka't gu chuukug.

Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai' gu ñi'ook gu tɨkɨr na ba' gu chuukug dhuuk gu oidha' gu ñi'ook na ba' jix bhai' aa' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu noobh; gio ba' gu takarui' mumua'da' chɨbɨɨp tu' cham jix bhɨɨ gu chuukug.

Jano' ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu ux mo'o cham gu ux gu jodai'; gio ba' dhi' tu jiim gu suudai' cham dhi' bɨtaa'n; na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook na ba' nukadham gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' cham tu' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook tu' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook tu' kɨɨ'n tu' gu jodai' na ba' tu' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' tu juan.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' cham gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu takarui' gu ux tu duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk tu' gu ñi'ook aajim bhaan tu' bɨx dhi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu kutun ka' kiicham gu kutun yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu kutun gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu kutun gu i'bhɨ vook gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' kakneer.
Jano' ba' gu kutun ka' baakɨi gu kutun jix buus.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' mu'ai gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' bɨx gu jodai' gu chuukug gu novɨ gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n jootom kuiñcha gu ñi'ook buimɨi gu ux gu oi'ñga'n tɨtda:―Cha'pim.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix koi bɨɨx ka'm tu' jix duñia' gu oidha' gu oi'ñga'n na ba' bia'ka'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n daada'n gu takarui' jix tónom gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu chuukug; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu tɨkɨr bhaan mo'o ka't gu jodai' na jix uam; gio ba' gu oidha' bɨtaa'n tu' jix kavɨk jodai.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu Jawatan Dios gu ux dhuuk gu oidha' oo' maatai; gio ba' gu tɨkɨr jix dhaav bhaan tu' bɨɨx ka'm gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' kapbhai' gu jodai' vupui bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' gu ux kɨɨv gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug vupui bhaan; mi' dhɨr ka' gu tasi' bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu chuukug jix koi gu ux jugi bɨx gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr gu vaakax gu oidha' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu Ejipto bɨɨx gu chuukug bɨɨx gu suudai' bɨɨx jugi cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu suudai' bɨɨx gu duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug saagi'ñ na ja'p jix duñia' bai'ñchu' gu tukgam cham ka' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk ka' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu tanoolh cham gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu takarui' bɨɨx gu u'vɨ gu chio'ñ jix koox bɨɨx; gio ba' gu suudai' gu vaak cham gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr gu ux na tu ibai' oidha' u'va cham gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' gu vaakax ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan gu vupui tu' cham jugi; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't jix duñia' vupui bhaan tu' cham tu' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr kakneer ka't gu oi'ñga'n obhɨɨ'ñ cham gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ ka't kapbhai' gu ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu ux bɨx gu tanoolh; gio ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu kavɨk gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' bɨx tu jiim jugi gu ja'tkam cham gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk ka' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' jix bhai'x bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt kuiñcha gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu vupui.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n kɨkbok gu takarui' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu suudai' dɨr gu vaas tɨɨt bɨɨx ka'm gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' tu' gu gɨ'kora' cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' gu ja'tkam cham gu bhóogɨt tu' tattat; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai.
Jano' ba' ka' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu ux daa'ñchu'nda' gu ux gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu ja'tkam tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix buusñi gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kai' yooxi' gu chuukug gu vaak; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu ux na tu ibai' oidha' u'va tu juan gu' cham i'i suudai' u'va tu' gu chuukug gu suudai'; na gu' nu'aidha' jugi.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook gu' cham tu' maa'n bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu'; na gu' suudai' u'u gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu jodai' cham ka't na ba' tu'; na gu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu jodai' gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan tu' gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x tu' ka' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' tu' cham gu takarui'; gio ba' ka't gu ux mo'o tu' ka' gu ux gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' aajim bhaan tu' bɨx dhi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu oi'ñga'n; na gu' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' nukadham gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk tu' jix aa'ñdhix.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ux nɨi'ñchudat gu ux gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu kai' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Na gu' na gu' cham gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu kutun bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ gu ux gu ñi'ook bɨx tu'x.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu jodai' obhɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios bhaan tu' bɨɨx bhiogi' bɨɨx gu chuukug bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨɨx uañi'ñ bɨx tu'x; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu tasi' jix kavɨk jodai bhaan baakux bɨɨx ka'm gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt bhaan tu' gu ja'tkam gu suudai' gu maa'nkar gu oidha' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu ja'tkam nɨɨn cham gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt gu vupui cham gu oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ jix bhai'x tu' uañi'ñka' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jugi gu i'bhɨ gu vaakax gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' cham tu' kiicha' kai'ñ tu' gu bhóogɨt tu' bɨ'ñdhatu' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' tu' kakneer bɨɨx ka'm gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' bɨx jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx ka'm gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' bɨx jɨ'dɨlh bɨx gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu oi'ñga'n jix maa.
Jano' ba' jugi gu i'bhɨ vook gu chuukug gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx tu' jix duñia' bhaamki'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ jix bhai'x tu' gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x gu vupui ka't gu bhóogɨt na ba' bɨɨx xibhɨk na ba' bɨɨx gu u'vɨ baaso na ba' bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu jodai'.
Na gu' na ba' cham gu chuukug oi'ñdha' gu chuukug gu ma'nkam jugi na gu' cham tu' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx bhaamki'ñdha' tu' gu bhóogɨt bɨx jɨ'dɨlh.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' cham pai' dhuuk gu vaas tɨɨt gu ñi'ook gu jodai' bhaan gu oidha' gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vupui ka't gu bhóogɨt na ba' bɨɨx gu chio'ñ baaso na ba' bɨɨx gu mar na ba' bɨɨx mar u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' na ba' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu chuukug tɨjɨɨ'ñ tɨɨt na ba' bɨɨx gu ma'nkam na ba'; na gu' jugi jix bhai'x uañi'ñ bɨx jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx bhaamki'ñdha' tu' gu bhóogɨt jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' tu' cham gu takarui' gu ux tu duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook gu chuukug ñi'ook na tu a'ga ua'ñix dhi' u'uan gu ñi'ook dhi' gu tɨɨgɨ' tas na jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu chuukug gu kai' gu chuukug dhi' dudua'ñ gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Ejipto vupui bhaan gu suudai' tu' jix duñia'.
